answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a 40 POA entry tax that is burned, not refunded, a sunk cost buying one work thread on the trellis of the network. A mirror check compares threads: fakes mirror each other, identical histories and counterparties, and are pruned together. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against about 200 POA in rewards, a net loss of 3,800. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its reward undiluted.
